name: star
sql: select * from source

name: columns
sql: select id, amount from source

name: alias
sql: select amount as total from source

name: math
sql: select id, amount * 2 + 1 as total from source

name: where
sql: select id from source where amount > 10

name: boolean
sql: select id from source where amount >= 10 and id < 4

name: distinct
sql: select distinct category from source

name: sort
sql: select id, amount from source order by amount desc, id

name: limit
sql: select id from source order by id limit 2

name: case
sql: select id, case when amount > 10 then 'big' else 'small' end as size from source

name: sum
sql: select sum(amount) as total from source

name: group
sql: select category, sum(amount) as total from source group by category

name: having
sql: select category, sum(amount) as total from source group by category having sum(amount)>20

name: count
sql: select category, count(*) as n from source group by category

name: avg
sql: select category, avg(amount) as mean from source group by category

name: minmax
sql: select min(amount) as lo, max(amount) as hi from source

name: cte
sql: with chosen as (select * from source where amount>10) select id from chosen

name: union
sql: select id from source where id<3 union select id from source where id>1

name: union_all
sql: select id from source where id<3 union all select id from source where id>1

name: subquery
sql: select id from (select * from source where amount>10) x

name: inner_join
sql: select s.id, o.label from source s inner join other o on s.id=o.id

name: left_join
sql: select s.id, o.label from source s left join other o on s.id=o.id

name: right_join
sql: select o.id, s.amount from source s right join other o on s.id=o.id

name: full_join
sql: select s.id as left_id, o.id as right_id from source s full join other o on s.id=o.id

name: cross_join
sql: select s.id, o.label from source s cross join other o

name: row_number
sql: select id, row_number() over(partition by category order by amount, id) as n from source

name: rank
sql: select id, rank() over(partition by category order by amount) as n from source

name: dense_rank
sql: select id, dense_rank() over(partition by category order by amount) as n from source

name: lag
sql: select id, lag(amount) over(partition by category order by id) as previous from source

name: lead
sql: select id, lead(amount,1,0) over(partition by category order by id) as next_amount from source

name: window_sum
sql: select id, sum(amount) over(partition by category order by id rows between 1 preceding and current row) as rolling from source

name: window_avg
sql: select id, avg(amount) over(partition by category order by id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as rolling from source

name: window_count
sql: select id, count(*) over(partition by category) as n from source

name: range_frame
sql: select id, sum(amount) over(order by id range between 1 preceding and 1 following) as total from source

name: in_subquery
sql: select id from source where id in (select id from other)

name: nulls
sql: select id, coalesce(amount,0) as value from source where amount is not null

name: strings
sql: select id, upper(category) as category from source where category like 'a%'

name: cast
sql: select cast(id as string) as id from source

name: count_distinct
sql: select count(distinct category) as n from source
